name: Hobis Backstube
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hobis Backstube in Garmisch-Partenkirchen**

Discover the cozy charm of this traditional bakery and café nestled in the heart of the **Alps**. Here, every bite tells a story of authentic Bavarian flavors and time-honored craftsmanship.

Indulge in freshly baked **Brezen**, crispy **Semmeln**, and fluffy **Kaiserschmarrn**—all made with love and the finest local ingredients. Pair your treats with a steaming cup of **Kaffee** or a frothy **Milchkaffee**, and let the warmth of the wooden interior wrap around you.

Whether you're a visitor exploring **Tirol** or a local seeking a taste of home, Hobis Backstube is your perfect stop. Come by for a break, a snack, or a hearty meal—every visit feels like stepping into a piece of Bavarian tradition.

**Prost!** 🍞☕
